caption: The slope of the line joining the two measured points is the average rate of pressure rise: 30 bar over 15° of crank angle, that is 2 bar per degree. A steeper line would mean a faster burn and a peak pressure nearer TDC.

spec.aria: Line from 10 degrees after TDC at 30 bar to 25 degrees after TDC at 60 bar; its slope is the average rate of pressure rise.
